header.p: Full-Stack Software Engineer & Open-Source Package Author from Bangladesh 🇧🇩. Passionate about high-throughput backend architecture, AI/LLM integrations, Cloudflare edge systems, and building custom FPV drone hardware.

div.p: From architecting web platforms and creating composer packages to fine-tuning LLMs and crafting FPV drone flight controllers.
Designing resilient microservices, queue systems, payment gateway drivers (NowPayments, bKash), and high-performance Laravel/Node APIs.
Developing autonomous agents (SohagAgent), RAG knowledge search pipelines, OpenAI streaming integrations, and Bengali Quranic LLM fine-tuning.
Building custom FPV quadcopters from bare components, coding ESP32 flight controller firmware, and reverse engineering DJI N1 telemetry protocols.
Authentic snapshots, verified profile avatars, and developer media from across my official channels.

div.p: Full-Stack Software Engineer & content creator authoring deep-dive engineering tutorials on YouTube.
Maintaining 90+ public repositories, open-source AI tools, and composer packages on GitHub and Packagist.
AIUB Computer Science alumni, researching low-resource Bengali NLP, autonomous agents, and FPV drone firmware.

div.p: Sharing programming guides, advanced backend patterns, web scraping architecture, and embedded IoT drone telemetry experiments.
Reusable PHP & Composer packages available for developers globally on packagist.org.
Intelligent PHP resume parsing library combining standard regex and OpenAI LLMs to extract structured resume data (contact info, skills, education, and experience) from PDF files.
A clean, object-oriented PHP SDK for the NowPayments.io API. Handles cryptocurrency payments, dynamic invoices, recurring deposits, and IPN webhook authentication.
Reliable PHP library designed to fetch, parse, and extract direct download streaming links for Facebook reels and video media with automated header spoofing.
Instagram media extraction utility package for developer automation workflows and media scrapers. Parses reels, IGTV, and carousel image batches.
A selection of web applications, AI platforms, hardware systems, and automation tools.
Autonomous AI agent interface featuring Jarvis-like GUI capabilities, tool calling, conversation memory, multimodal streaming, and Python subroutines.
Direct farmer-to-consumer digital marketplace with distinct farmer management portals, admin commissions, real-time inventory, and bKash payments.
Custom ESP32 firmware acting as a hardware communication bridge and telemetry aggregator with DJI N1 protocols for high-speed drone data streaming.
Fine-tuning open-source LLM architectures (DeepSeek & LLaMA) on Bengali Islamic scholarship, translation, and semantic tafseer question answering.
Automated exploitation scripts, crypto solvers, and reverse engineering toolkits crafted during participation in EWU CTF, Shibir CTF, and web pentesting.
Self-hosted container provisioning platform with Nginx reverse proxy configuration, automated SSL certificates via Let's Encrypt, and Cloudflare Workers KV.
Technologies, frameworks, and developer environments utilized in daily production engineering.
